rule.quote: 每一個預告句用回收它的那一章的畫面（同一張圖）

source_text: 它改把兩張薄膜的接觸面加熱，趁表面能融合時施壓，直接熔成接縫。
reuse_text: 可兩張膜之間那條細細的接縫，會讓這個設計碰到一道意外的難題。
pairs.prompt: Close-up at a workbench, one anonymous technician holding the overlapping edges of two plain translucent films together beside a raised-cell sample, soft side light.
pairs.composed_prompt: Close-up at a workbench, one anonymous technician holding the overlapping edges of two plain translucent films together beside a raised-cell sample, soft side light.. Style: cute Taiwanese YouTube explainer cartoon: chibi characters with big round heads, large expressive eyes and exaggerated comic expressions, thick clean dark outlines, flat colours with soft cel shading, a limited palette of deep navy night, parchment yellow, muted teal and one warning-red accent, subtle paper grain, simple clear backgrounds, one subject in the centre third, playful and friendly, 16:9. Camera: tilt up
pairs.no_result_drawn_in_teaser: Two overlapping films and a raised-cell sample show the joint being handled, without drawing heat, a melted seam, machinery settings or the later solution.

official_command_recipe.step: Payoff first, only after all admission and review gates
Before running teaser: require the exact live-cache key and on-disk bytes/SHA to match the accepted payoff; stop on miss to prevent a new dispatch

preconditions: Exact current independent source/visual review, current narrative-bound owner approvals, admitted new-remake budget account/history/all-in quote, and formal branding requirements remain mandatory. This plan authorizes no provider call.

Read actual provider/model/size/version/seed/references/look/composed prompt and correction list before production; the native keys recorded here are declared planned examples, not current backend settings.

Generate and pass each payoff first through the normal keyframes --shot --takes 1 route with seed 1. Before the teaser command, use the ordinary read-only cache reader and actual bytes/SHA to prove the same key is present and points to the accepted payoff file. If not present or changed, stop; do not allow the teaser command to dispatch a fresh image.
production_handoff.on_any_failure: Stop the pair. Each scene retains its own official judge. Do not reroll a second seed, independently buy a similar picture, bypass a failed judge, or hand-edit a manifest. Any changed request, retake, trim or selection requires both ends to be reconciled under the normal gates.
required_actual_checks: Both final official manifest scene assignments and their actual file bytes/SHA256 are identical.
If margin trimming creates derived files, compare those actual selected derived files too; equality of an earlier original is insufficient.
Each scene has its own passing official image judgment and valid receipts.
Both assembly inputs reference that same accepted selected image; the ledger contains no duplicate teaser image purchase.
